newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: UBS continues to rate Ems as "hold".
newsitem.headline: UBS continues to rate Ems as "hold".

text.p: Union Bank of Switzerland (UBS) continues to rate Swiss specialty chemicals firm EMS Chemie Holding AG as "hold" in a model portfolio, UBS said in an analysts' report.
UBS said the concern's group operating profit of 67 million Swiss francs for the first eight months of 1996 was slightly below its expectations. EMS announced eight-month results on September 20.
But, based on a better situation for orders and a slightly weaker Swiss franc, UBS said it maintained its profit forecast for the current year and was keeping EMS as a hold.
It forecast operating profit of 140 million Swiss francs for the entire year, which would be an increase of 1.6 percent versus the previous year. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
